title: Light & Celebration
subtitle: Autumn 2 · 6-week overview
summary: Exploring how different cultures use light to celebrate, creating light-inspired art with a range of materials, sharing stories of celebrations of light and building confidence in group activities.
intentions: To explore how different cultures use light in their celebrations e.g. Hanukkah, Bonfire Night and Christmas.
To use a range of materials and techniques to create artwork inspired by light.
To listen to stories linked to celebrations of light
Developing confidence when cooperating in group activities
books: Twinkly, Twinkly Night-Time by Sam Taplin

events.label: Remembrance Day: Making paper plate poppies.
World Kindness Day: ‘Hands are not for Hitting’ Book.
World Hello Day: Saying “hello” in different languages.

days.title: Glow Stick Bottles
days.what: Collect empty water bottles (plastic VOS ones) and put glow sticks inside. Turn the lights off and encourage the children to shake the bottles, looking at the lights and different colours.

days.title: Rolling light up balls
days.what: Provide some light up balls and encourage the children to roll them back and forth either with each other or a staff member.

days.title: Firework blotching
days.what: Provide the children with black card and metallic blotchers. Allow the children to make marks.

days.title: Playdough birthday cakes
days.what: Set up the playdough at the table with some tools. Encourage the children to make ‘birthday cakes’ and sing happy birthday.

days.title: ‘Twinkly, Twinkly Night-Time’ by Sam Taplin
days.what: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Light up balloons
days.what: Provide balloons with lights inside. Make the room dark so that the lights can be seen. Encourage the children to play and explore.

days.title: Light dance party
days.what: Darken the room, turn on the disco light, provide torches and play familiar music. Allow the children to make sounds and explore the lights.

days.title: Handprint turkeys
days.what: Use the children’s hands and paint to make turkeys for Thanksgiving!

days.title: Small world arctic animals
days.what: Set up blue water and the arctic animals in the messy play tray. Allow the children to explore, talking about the colour of the water, the temperature and the different animals.

days.title: ‘Busy Hanukkah’
days.what: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.

days.title: Christmas decorations exploration
days.what: Provide different Christmas decorations e.g. tinsel, baubles, jingle bells, etc. and allow the children to explore the different sounds and textures.

days.title: Dancing and freezing with lights
days.what: Turn off the lights and give the children a torch. Play some music and pause it in intervals, encouraging the children to also freeze with their torches.

days.title: Christmas cards
days.what: Complete Christmas cards with the children to give to their families.

days.title: Christmas market pretend play
days.what: Set up the home corner with a mix of pretend food and real food. Provide the children with baskets and encourage them to collect food in their baskets as if they are shopping.

days.title: ‘Busy Christmas’ by Campbell Books
days.what: Read at circle time with enthusiasm.
